title: Emergent Holographic Forces from Tensor Networks and Criticality
abstract: Formulates an efficiently implementable multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) model of AdS/CFT providing a mapping between a (1+1)-dimensional critical spin system and a (2+1)-dimensional bulk theory. The bulk theory furnishes excitations (hologrons) with attractive interactions matching predictions for matter coupled to AdS gravity at long distances. Key parameters: l_AdS^{-1} = 0.69(1) ~ log(2), mc^2 = 2.5(1), C1 = 0.080(8), C2 = 13.6(8).
key_claims: Hologron interaction potential matches AdS gravity predictions at long distances
Force is attractive, quasilocal, and position-dependent (not just distance)
l_AdS = 1/log(2) = 1.4427 emerges from binary MERA structure
Interaction potential: V_TN(|rho1-rho2|) ~ C1 - C2 * exp(-|rho1-rho2|/l_AdS)
Radial boost factor b_AdS encodes relativistic rest-frame corrections
